ideas.title: Your N8N Workflow Is Held Together By Duct Tape
ideas.concept: A myth-bust post calling out the DIY automation crowd who stitch together 40-node N8N workflows without error handling, retries, or logging. Visual would be a screenshot of a chaotic, tangled N8N canvas next to a clean, modular version — a 'before vs. how a pro builds it' side-by-side.
ideas.hook: If your automation breaks and you don't find out for 3 days, you don't have an automation. You have a liability.

ideas.title: The Google Workspace Stack I'd Rebuild From Scratch
ideas.concept: A tool breakdown post showing the exact Google Workspace + Claude + N8N stack Alfie uses to run Accelod — Gmail filters feeding Claude for triage, Docs auto-generated from Sheets, Calendar events triggering GHL sequences. Visual: a clean flowchart with logos and arrows showing data movement between the four tools.
ideas.hook: Most business owners use 4% of Google Workspace. Here's what the other 96% looks like when you plug Claude into it.

ideas.title: The Electrician Who Replaced His Office Manager With A Workflow
ideas.concept: A case study post about a real trades client who eliminated a $45k/year admin role by combining GoHighLevel for lead intake, Claude for quote generation, and N8N for job scheduling. Visual: a split graphic — 'Before: 1 office manager, 3 spreadsheets, missed jobs' vs. 'After: 1 workflow, 0 dropped leads, sleeps in on Sundays.'
ideas.hook: He didn't fire her because she was bad. He fired her because a workflow was better.

He didn't answer a single call.

Meet Dave. A plumber drowning in missed calls, unanswered texts, and lost leads.

We built him a system with N8N + GoHighLevel that:

→ Sends quotes automatically
→ Books the job straight into his calendar

All while he's asleep. Or on a job. Or with his kids.

3 confirmed bookings between 11pm and 6am. Zero human effort.

Still answering every enquiry manually?
